acceptance: Red first: an orphan test server whose owner pid is dead is stopped
Red first: a server whose owner pid is alive stays
No test signals a real process
fix: Extend the lister to the registered test socket dirs and keep the owner-pid rule. Tie the life of a test tmux server to its test binary. Inject the signal sender in each test.
summary: Plan PR #1585, check K10, component X8. On 2026-11-20, 282 tmux servers on sockets evolve-bridge-t<N> had ppid 1 (276 older than a day). swarm.ReapOrphanSockets has the right owner-pid rule (go/internal/swarm/reap_orphans.go:111) but its lister (:123-125) reads only its own socket dir (go/internal/bridge/tmux.go:90-95); test binaries use TMUX_TMPDIR=/tmp/evtmux* (go/cmd/evolve/main_test.go:56-61).
title: The orphan socket reaper sees the test tmux socket dirs, and test servers end with their test binary
